draft.headline: Updates on open-source Linux security runtime and Salesforce CPQ certification timelines.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.text:
- OpenAI and Cisco launched Shirudo, an open-source runtime designed to help protect Linux systems.
- Codex-generated shields blocked a Java4Shell exploit against a running Elasticsearch service without needing a restart during controlled tests.
- Shirudo utilizes eBPF and Trusted Platform Modules to support verifiable protection records.
stories.why_it_matters: Review infrastructure security standards for Linux systems hosting integrations to evaluate potential runtime protections.

stories.title: What Happened to CPQ? A Timeline of Salesforce’s Most Controversial Product
stories.text:
- Salesforce confirmed that CPQ entered End of Sale status in March 2025, meaning no new customers are added while existing customers retain support and renewals.
- Twenty-four certifications are retiring, including the CPQ Administrator exam which had its final day to sit on August 31, 2026, and officially retires on February 1, 2027.
- Salesforce previously announced the acquisition of SteelBrick in December 2015 for $360M.
stories.why_it_matters: Audit client org roadmaps to prepare for upcoming CPQ certification retirements and End of Sale policies.
